remarks: Escape the everyday and indulge in the beauty of your own private retreat. Nestled on 1.1 acres of lush at the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac, this expansive Colonial masterfully blends classic elegance with modern flair. Every inch of this home invites relaxation, entertainment, and immersion in nature's sights and sounds-all in one of Stamford's most sought-after, welcoming neighborhoods. Step into a dramatic two-story marble foyer with a sweeping open staircase that sets the tone for the home's grandeur. The gourmet eat-in kitchen flows seamlessly into a cozy family room with fireplace and custom built-ins. Both spaces open onto the rear balcony. A main-level bonus room with full bath and shower offers flexible use as a guest suite, home office, or in-law accommodation.  The 1,200 sq ft primary suite is a true sanctuary. It features a luxurious marble fireplace, soaring beamed ceilings, a spacious dressing/sitting room with abundant closet space, and a private home office or den with vaulted ceiling, skylights, and French doors leading to a balcony. The bath includes a jetted tub, walk-in shower, and double vanity. The finished walkout lower level offers 10-foot ceilings, large sliders to the scenic backyard, and bright, open spaces perfect for a media room, gym, or play area-tailored for every lifestyle.
